text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And Biwa Hayahide wins with a<n>blowout victory!
What an incredible<n>time!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Both of these sisters are absolutely<n>amazing! The
stage is now set for a<n>sibling showdown!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm back. We've done it.We've seized victory.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thanks. That's another one on the<n>books, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I... I really did it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I took first place among the very<n>select few that are
invited to<n>participate in the Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She smiles proudly.
choice_data_list: You've worked so hard for this.
You've worked so hard for this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: We both did! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But we have some work to do. I still<n>need to beat
Brian in a race for the<n>ages.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And there's one question I must<n>answer before we
can make our<n>battle a reality.
choice_data_list:
Is it which race you want to compete against her
in?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Exactly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, I've managed to gather<n>some data
pertaining to that issue.<n>Take a look at these articles

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian Aims for the Kikuka Sho...<n>That's no
surprise. I'm sure she'll<n>become a Triple Crown
Champion.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then there's these. "Potential<n>Year-End Sisterly
Showdown?" and<n>"Is the Arima Kinen in Narita
Brian's<n>Future?"...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As these articles suggest, I believe<n>she'll go to the
Arima Kinen instead<n>of the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And I know she'll show up to the<n>race in perfect
condition.
choice_data_list: So the showdown will be at the Arima Kinen, huh?
So the showdown will be at the Arima Kinen, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It looks that way. While she's honing<n>her skills in
the Kikuka Sho, I want to<n>make my mark in a G1
race this fall.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We need to schedule everything<n>around the Arima
Kinen. We'll have to<n>prepare for a battle of sheer
speed<n>against Narita Brian.
choice_data_list: Let's tackle the autumn Tenno Sho, then.
Let's tackle the autumn Tenno Sho, then.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence. I was just about<n>to suggest
the same.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Vrrrrmmm...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from the Hanshin<n>Racecourse, we
set our sights on the<n>autumn Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Zzz... zzz...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I hear Biwa Hayahide breathing softly<n>as she
sleeps in the seat next to me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's been falling fast asleep after<n>almost every
race lately.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's no surprise. Putting everything<n>she has into
each race must be<n>exhausting.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We'll need to come up with a plan to<n>help her
recover from the fatigue and<n>keep her at peak
performance.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I come up with as many ideas as I<n>can for her on
the bus ride home.
